steps.text: Go to the second floor of Ardougne Castle.
Talk to King Lathas.
Talk to Koftik in West Ardougne.
Talk to Koftik in West Ardougne.
Talk to Koftik outside the West Ardougne cave.
Enter the dungeon.
Climb-over rockslide.
Climb-over rockslide.
Climb-over rockslide.
Talk to Koftik inside the cave.
Search the abandoned equipment for an oily cloth.
Use the oily cloth on an arrow.
Use the tinderbox on the fire arrow. If you don't have a tinderbox, use the arrow on the nearby fire instead.
Walk to the room north of Koftik.
Wield a lit arrow and shoot the guide-rope.
Follow the path west to leave.
Pick up the plank in the north room.
Swing across the pit with a rope.
Climb-over rockslide
Climb-over rockslide
Cross the grid by trial and error. Keep health above 15, and remember the path for Regicide.
Pull the lever to raise the gate.
Either disable or walk past the traps.
Either disable or walk past the traps.
Either disable or walk past the traps.
Either disable or walk past the traps.
Either disable or walk past the traps.
Take the first orb of light.
Use a plank on the flat rock to cross it.
Use a plank on the flat rock to cross it.
Use a plank on the flat rock to cross it.
Take the second orb of light north west of the well.
Take the third orb of light west of the well. Remember to use a plank on the flat rocks to cross them.
Search the flat rock to remove the trap and take the fourth orb to the south west of the well.

steps.text: Return to the furnace to the east, and use the orbs on it.
Climb down the well.
Navigate the maze, or use the shortcut to the south with 50 Thieving.
Pick the lock to enter the cell.
Dig the loose mud.
Cross the ledge.
Enter the pipe to the next section.
Search the unicorn cage.
Use the railing on the boulder.
Search the cage again.
Enter the tunnel.
Travel through the tunnel to find some knights.
Kill Sir Jerro and take his badge. Optionally: talk to one of the knights first to receive food and potions.
Kill Sir Carl and take his badge.
Kill Sir Harry and take his badge.
Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
Open the door at the end of the path.
Follow the edge of the cavern down to enter a cave on the south wall.
Talk to Niloof.
Return up to Iban's Cavern.
Start from the south east corner of the bridges, and go northwest along them and retrieve the witch's cat.
Use the cat on the witch's door in the south east corner of the area to distract her.
Search the chest in the witch's house. You'll need 4 empty inventory slots.
From the south east corner of the area, head west then south along the pathways. Kill Holthion and pick up his amulet.
Kill Doomion and pick up his amulet.
Kill Othainian and pick up his amulet.
Use the shadow on the doll.
Search the chest north of Doomion.
Use the ashes on the doll.
Use the dove on the doll.
Return to the dwarf encampment on the lower level.
Pick up a bucket in the large dwarf encampment building.
Pick up a tinderbox in the small dwarf encampment building.
Use a bucket on the brew barrel in the dwarf encampment on the south west.
Use the bucket of brew on the tomb in the south east corner of the area.
Light the tomb with a tinderbox.
Kill Kalrag the spider. Protect From Melee can keep you safe in this fight.
Ascend to the upper level of the cave again via the north west exit.
Search the marked cage in the north west of the area while wearing Klank's gauntlets.
Travel along the pathways from the north west corner of the area to the middle. Kill a disciple of Iban and take their robes.
Enter the Temple of Iban wearing monk robes. Prepare to use Iban's doll on the well, as Iban can deal lots of damage quickly.
Right-click USE the doll on the well. Standing north of the well can prevent Iban from hitting.
Talk to Koftik.
Return to King Lathas to finish the quest.
Return to King Lathas to finish the quest.
Talk to Klank to obtain his gauntlets. If you've done so before, you may need to pay 5,000gp for them.
